newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-mo T-bill yields fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-mo T-bill yields fall slightly.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills dipped to 48.36 percent from 48.51 percent at the last sale on December 12, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 10.43 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.31 million UAH 13.38 million UAH
The central bank sold 104,299 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 21,784 were competitive and 82,515 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 19.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.40 from 59.50 percent at the last sale on December 12, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 22.64 million UAH 25.99 million UAH
Actual amount raised 17.46 million UAH 20.05 million UAH
The central bank sold 226,375 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 158,552 were competitive and 67,823 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 19.
The Finance Ministry cancelled without explanation the sale of 9- and 12-month Treasury bills on December 17. The next auctions for the T-bills are scheduled for December 19.
